_help: Site-wide settings. Edit, then run: python3 build.py && python3 build.py --check. See README.md.
name: Makers Inspire
_logo_help: Path to the black-and-white logo, e.g. "assets/logo.svg". null = text wordmark.
_checkout_help: Checkout uses Stripe Payment Links: paste each piece's link (https://buy.stripe.com/...) into its stripe_link in pieces.json. Pieces without a link show an 'Ask about this piece' button that opens the contact form.
_form_help: POST endpoint for the commission + contact forms. Works with FormSubmit-style endpoints, e.g. "https://formsubmit.co/<email>" (sends _subject, _template=table, _captcha, _next=/thanks/ and the _honey honeypot). null = submitting opens the visitor's email app with a prefilled message to contact_email. form_captcha: false sends _captcha=false.
_contact_help: Confirmed address (provided by Noah). Shown on the Contact page; also used by the forms' mailto fallback while form_endpoint is null.
